dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はご相談にお越し下さり、ありがとうございます。はじめに、年齢、性別、ご相談内容を聞かせていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 32歳女性主人のことで相談があります。
dialogue.English: I'm a 32-year-old woman, and I'd like to talk about my husband.

dialogue.content: 話すと長くなるのですが。。
dialogue.English: It's a bit of a long story...

dialogue.content: よろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Is that alright?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ聞いているので続けてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Yes, yes—I'm listening. Please go on.

dialogue.content: 娘が今6歳です。少し知能が遅れていて。
dialogue.English: My daughter is six years old. She has a bit of a developmental delay.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 来年から小学校に上がるので、昨日病院に行って調べてもらったら4歳の知能と言われました。。
dialogue.English: She'll be starting elementary school next year, so we went to the hospital yesterday for an evaluation, and they told us she has the cognitive level of a four-year-old.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それは、ご心配ですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very worrying for you.

dialogue.content: 主人に話したらお前がそんな子供を産んだんだ。娘は、普通だと言って、理解しようとしてくれません。
dialogue.English: When I told my husband, he said, "You're the one who gave birth to a child like that." He insists our daughter is normal and won't even try to understand.

dialogue.content: 辛くて、どうしたらいいのか
dialogue.English: It's so painful, and I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私は、どうしたらいいんでしょうか。。
dialogue.English: What should I do...?

dialogue.content: まずは、大切はお話をしてくださり本当に有難う御座います。
dialogue.English: First of all, thank you very much for sharing such a personal and important story with me.

dialogue.content: はい。。
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 娘様が６歳であられて、昨日病院で４歳の知能と言われてしまったと、それは本当に心配ですよね。お辛い気持ちでしたよね。
dialogue.English: So your daughter is six, and yesterday at the hospital, you were told she has the intelligence of a four-year-old. That must be incredibly worrying. It must have been very painful to hear.

dialogue.content: そうですね。わかってはいましたが、実際に言われると辛いです。
dialogue.English: Yes. I had an idea, but hearing it said out loud is painful.

dialogue.content: それは、そうですよね。辛い気持ちになりますよね
dialogue.English: Of course, I can understand that. It's natural to feel hurt.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 旦那様は、相談者様がそんな子供を産んだんだ。娘様は、普通なんだと、おっしゃったと言う事ですが、普段から旦那様とはどんなご関係か少し伺ってもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned your husband said, 'You're the one who gave birth to a child like that,' and that your daughter is normal. Could I ask a little about what your relationship with your husband is usually like?

dialogue.content: はい。主人は、普段から亭主関白なところがあり。何か言うと怒りだすので。私もあまり、意見はしません。
dialogue.English: Yes. My husband tends to be very domineering. If I say anything, he gets angry, so I don't express my opinions much.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それはお辛いですよね。もしかしたら普段からご自宅に余り安心感なんかがないのではないかと感じていますが如何でしょうか？後、最初に聞いておけばよかったのですが、同居のご家族は相談者様と旦那様、娘様の三名で宜しかったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be difficult for you. I get the sense that perhaps you don't feel a strong sense of security at home; would that be right? Also, I should have asked at the beginning, but is it just the three of you—yourself, your husband, and your daughter—living together?

dialogue.content: 安心感がないというのは、私のことでしょうか。
dialogue.English: When you say a lack of a sense of security, are you talking about me?

dialogue.content: 家族は3人です。
dialogue.English: There are three of us in the family.

dialogue.content: 有難う御座います。はい、何か言うと怒り出すと言うことで少し緊張感を感じてしまうのかなと私なりに、想像しておりました。違っていたらすみません。ご家族3名教えてくださり有難う御座います。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Yes, I was imagining that because he gets angry when you say something, you might feel a bit of tension. I apologize if I'm mistaken. Thank you for confirming it's a family of three.

dialogue.content: そうですね。機嫌が良い時は、とても優しくて良い人なんですが
dialogue.English: That's right. When he's in a good mood, he's very kind and a good person, but...

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: いつ、機嫌が悪くなるかきわからないので、緊張はします。
dialogue.English: I never know when his mood will turn, so I do feel on edge.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it is.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 有難う御座います。では、再度質問させて頂いてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. May I ask another question, then?

dialogue.content: はい。大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: 今日の、ご相談はお子様の事での不安や悩みをご主人様にお話した所
dialogue.English: Today's consultation is about how when you shared your worries and anxieties regarding your child with your husband—

dialogue.content: 質問は、どういったことでしょうか。。
dialogue.English: What is your question, exactly...?

dialogue.content: すみません言葉を考えていて、遅くなってしまいました。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry—I was thinking about how to phrase it and kept you waiting.

dialogue.content: 相談者様のせいで全てこうなっているんだと、一緒に考えてくれないので、旦那様と分かり合えない辛さを持ってると言う事で宜しかったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it correct to say that you're feeling the pain of not being able to see eye-to-eye with your husband, because he won't think about this with you and instead makes it seem like everything is your fault?

dialogue.content: 前文が上記のこちらです。今日の、ご相談はお子様の事での不安や悩みをご主人様にお話した所
dialogue.English: The beginning of my sentence was the part above: "Today, when you shared your worries about your child with your husband—"

dialogue.content: 全てこうなったと言われているわけではなくて。。
dialogue.English: It's not that he's saying everything is my fault...

dialogue.content: でも、わかりあえない辛さはあります。。
dialogue.English: But there is the pain of not being able to understand each other...

dialogue.content: はい、表現が間違っていて申し訳ありません。
dialogue.English: I see—I'm sorry for phrasing it incorrectly.

dialogue.content: 分かり合えない辛さがあるのですね。一番身近なパートナーと分かり合えないのは凄く辛いことだと思います。
dialogue.English: So there is that pain of not being able to see eye-to-eye. I imagine it's very painful not to be able to connect with your closest partner.

dialogue.content: 私も、わかりにくいお話しでごめんなさい
dialogue.English: I'm sorry if my explanation is hard to understand.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: いえ、とんでもありません。相談者様がご丁寧にお話くださっているので
dialogue.English: No, not at all. You're sharing very thoughtfully, so—

dialogue.content: 凄く分かりやすいですよ＾＾有難う御座います
dialogue.English: It's very easy to understand. Thank you. ^^

dialogue.content: いえ、昨日のことなので、頭と心が混乱していて、すいません。
dialogue.English: No—it's just that it all happened yesterday, so my head and heart are in turmoil. I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です＾＾今打ち込んでますのでお待ちくださいね
dialogue.English: It's alright. ^^ I'm typing right now, so please give me a moment.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: もう一点、少し聞きずらいのですが、心配なので聞かせてください。すぐ怒られると言う事でしたが暴力を振るわれたりはないでしょうか？センシティブな問題なのでもし、違っていたらすみません。
dialogue.English: There's one more thing I'd like to ask, though it may be difficult to talk about. I'm concerned, so please let me ask. You mentioned he gets angry easily, but has he ever been physically violent? This is a sensitive topic, so please forgive me if I'm mistaken.

dialogue.content: 言葉の暴力はありますが、身体の暴力はないです。
dialogue.English: There is verbal abuse, but no physical violence.

dialogue.content: なるほど、有難う御座います。身体への暴力はないが、言葉の暴力はあるのですね。これはお辛いですね。今は、身体への暴力はないかもしれませんが
dialogue.English: I see, thank you for telling me. So there is no physical violence, but there is verbal abuse. That must be very hard on you. There may not be physical violence now, but...

dialogue.content: 怖がらせるわけでは無いのですが、今後、ないのが一番ですがエスカレートしてもし、あった場合はしっかりご自分の身を守ってくださいね。
dialogue.English: I don't mean to scare you, and it's best if it never happens, but if things do escalate in the future, please make sure you protect yourself.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 失礼は承知で言わせていただきました。分かってくださり有難う御座います。
dialogue.English: I said that knowing it might be intrusive. Thank you for understanding.

dialogue.content: では、改めて聞いて行きたいのですが
dialogue.English: Now, I'd like to ask again—

dialogue.content: 相談者様が今抱えているご主人様と分かり合えない辛さがあると言う事ですが、どうなって行きたいとお考えでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned the pain of not being able to see eye to eye with your husband. How would you like things to be going forward?

dialogue.content: そうですね。。子供のことに、向き合って一緒に考えていければと思います。
dialogue.English: Well... I hope we can face our child's situation and think it through together.

dialogue.content: 有難う御座います。お子様の事に一緒に向き合って欲しいと言う事ですよね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. So you want him to face your child's situation together with you, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 先ほどは何か言うと直ぐに怒られると言う事でしたが。お子様の事を又お話しても同じ結果になりそうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that he gets angry as soon as you say anything. If you were to talk about your child again, do you think the result would be the same?

dialogue.content: 昨日、話して言われているのて同じ事を言われると思います。
dialogue.English: Since I talked to him yesterday and he said what he said, I think he'll just say the same thing.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。有難う御座います。お話した場所はご自宅でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you. Did you have that conversation at home?

dialogue.content: いえ、病院の帰りに待ち合わせして、ファミレスに行った時に話しました。
dialogue.English: No, we met up on the way back from the hospital and talked when we went to a family restaurant.

dialogue.content: なるほど、有難う御座います。外でもそうなってしまうのであれば相当怒り感情が強い方であられると推測しますので
dialogue.English: I see, thank you. If he acts that way even in public, I would infer that his anger is quite strong, so—

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一点向き合っていく為に私から、お話させて頂いてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: To help you both face this, may I offer a suggestion?

dialogue.content: お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 直ぐに怒り出すというのはアンガーマネジメント（怒りのコントロール）が出来ていない状態です。
dialogue.English: Getting angry immediately is a sign that he isn't able to manage his anger (anger control).

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まず、冷静に怒りが出せない。感情的になれない状況を作る事で
dialogue.English: First, by creating a situation where he can't get emotional or lash out in anger—

dialogue.content: 怒りに任せた感情のぶつけ方にならなくなると考えています。
dialogue.English: I believe it will prevent him from lashing out in anger.

dialogue.content: はぁ。。難しくてよくわかりませんが。。
dialogue.English: Hmm... It sounds difficult, and I don't really understand...

dialogue.content: だとしたら、私はどうしたらいいんでしょうか。
dialogue.English: If that's the case, what should I do?

dialogue.content: そうですよね。難しい言葉ですみません
dialogue.English: You're right. I apologize for using difficult terms.

dialogue.content: いえ。知識不足ですいません。
dialogue.English: No, I'm sorry for my lack of knowledge.

dialogue.content: はい、相談者様のご両親とこの事をお話されたら如何でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Well, how about discussing this with your parents?

dialogue.content: すいません。両親は他界しているので
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, my parents have passed away.

dialogue.content: 兄弟もいなく、話せる人がいなくて、こちらに話を聴いてもらいたくて来ました。
dialogue.English: I don't have any siblings either. I have no one to talk to, which is why I came here hoping you would listen.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そんな状態でご相談に来てくださり有難う御座います
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for coming to talk to me, especially under these circumstances.

dialogue.content: 冷静に現実を受け取っていただける環境を作ると言う事でしたが、ご両親は他界されているのですね。では、旦那様のご両親との相談者様の仲は如何でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I was suggesting creating an environment where the reality can be received calmly, but I understand your parents have passed away. In that case, what is your relationship like with your husband's parents?

dialogue.content: 遠方に住んでいますが、付かず離れず、ごく一般的な感じです。
dialogue.English: They live far away, and our relationship is neither close nor distant—quite ordinary.

dialogue.content: 有難う御座います。もしくは、どちらかの信頼できるご友人を同席して話をするのも手ではあります。今の話を聞いて、頼めるような方は思い当たりますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Another option is to have a trusted friend of either of you present when you talk. Hearing that, does anyone come to mind whom you could ask?

dialogue.content: う～ん、難しいです。今は思い当たりません。。
dialogue.English: Hmm, that would be difficult. I can't think of anyone right now.

dialogue.content: なるほど、有難う御座います。今日は時間になってしまいましたが、旦那様にお話を聞いて頂く状態を
dialogue.English: I see, thank you. We've run out of time for today, but in order to create a situation where your husband will listen to you...

dialogue.content: 作って頂くために、又一緒に考えて行きたいと思います。本日は1時間ですのでまだ、解決には至っていないですがここから、もっと一緒に考えて行きたいと思っております。如何でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'd like us to continue thinking together about how to create that. Today's session was just one hour, so we haven't reached a resolution yet, but I'd like to continue working on this together from here. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: すいません。子供のご飯の準備がありますのでここで終わらせてください。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry. I need to prepare my child's dinner, so I'd like to end here, please.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はいこちらこそ本日は、有難うございます＾＾お時間になりましたのでこちらで終えせていただこうと思います。お手数をおかけしてしまいますが、率直なFBを頂けると幸いです。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you as well for coming today. Our time is up, so we will end here. I know it's an extra step, but I would appreciate it if you could provide some frank feedback.
